description: We would like to save your learning progress on your computer. But only if you say yes. Without a yes, the site forgets your quizzes and checkpoints after this visit. With a yes, everything stays.

essential.description: Basic things like language and colors. These are always saved.
essential.title: Basic Functions

progress.description: Saves which quizzes, checkpoints, and learning paths you finished. Only on your computer. It is off until you turn it on.
progress.title: Learning Progress

settingsDescription: Choose what to save on your computer
title: Cookie Notice

analytics.description: If you allow it, I count which pages are used. Then I also see: how long you stay on a page, how far you scroll, and which browser you use. These numbers only go to my own server — not to other companies. I do not know who you are. What exactly I count is shown on the statistics page.
analytics.title: Statistics
